ghent-render.note: Full page rasterization (interpret + paint + toImage) via benchmark_render_test on the headless Flutter engine; captures paint + image-decode gains the NullDevice vm-sweep can't. Driven by env vars, not perf_sweep.

image-heavy.note: Heavy per-page RGB images (~8 MB decoded RGBA each, ~196 MB total) - the #283 scanned/photo memory shape. Exercises image decode + peak RSS / the decoded-image-cache budget work (#307/#314). Generated once + pre-seeded into tool/perf/cache/image-heavy so every version measures identical input.

image-render.note: Rasterizes the image-heavy doc (image decode + paint). Same generated corpus as image-heavy.

devicen-render.note: Rasterizes a DeviceN-image doc (3-colorant /DeviceN + type-4 tint -> CMYK, banded samples). The tint transform runs at decode, so this isolates the #282 memoisation: renderMs collapses ~2530 ms/page (1.4.6) -> ~98 ms/page (1.4.7). Generated + pre-seeded.

cad-wide-1p-sweep.note: the pathological single-sheet strip drawing behind the iPad-jank report: one ~8504x842pt page, ~850k paint commands in 8 /Contents streams. Exercises interpret + peak RSS + text-extract on a transcript that overflows the region-replay linear ceiling. HEAD-only (new generator), never backfilled.

cad-images-1p-sweep.note: the image-heavy variant of the wide CAD strip, profiled from a real 62 MB cathodic-protection sheet rather than guessed: 1386 tiles of 2048x1754 (918 one-bit /ImageMask stencils, 450 DeviceRGB, 18 Indexed - all FlateDecode, no SMasks) under ~500k vector ops in 8 /Contents streams. ~4979 Mpx, so the page would decode to ~20 GB of RGBA from a ~78 MB file: the decoded-image-cache-budget shape. Also the only perf doc exercising the 1-bit ImageMask stencil path. Pre-seeded into tool/perf/cache/cad-images.

cad-images-mixed-sweep.note: the same sheet re-encoded with DCTDecode and JPXDecode tiles, for decoder coverage the faithful profile cannot give (the real file is Flate-only). CAVEAT: a non-CMYK DCTDecode base is handed to the platform codec (ui.instantiateImageCodec), not our Dart code, so on a vm-sweep only the JPX and Flate tiles exercise us - the JPEG half needs a flutter-render suite to mean anything. Generation needs cjpeg + opj_compress locally; pre-seeded, never generated in CI.

raster-underlay-render.note: Rasterizes the giant-image survey sheet: two 9460x2918 DCTDecode underlays, each under a full-size non-DCT gray /SMask, plus 71 OCG layers. This is the scenario that means something for the pathology - a non-CMYK DCTDecode base goes to the platform codec (ui.instantiateImageCodec), and the Flate soft mask forces the base back to RGBA for a per-pixel alpha-multiply; both run at native resolution unless capped to display size. ~220 MB RGBA resident. Generation needs cjpeg locally; pre-seeded into tool/perf/cache/raster-underlay, never generated in CI.

cad-133p-scroll.note: app/tool/perf loop against the real local CAD PDF ($PERF_PDF); manual/local only

cad-synthetic-scroll.note: app/tool/perf loop against the generated cad-138p corpus; used by perf-web.yml

type3-text-sweep.note: 6 A4 pages of dense two-column Type3 text (~7400 glyphs/page, 26 CharProcs: half vector bars, half TeX-pk-style 1-bit inline ImageMasks). The #535 anchor. Note: inline images make the worker wire codec DECLINE these pages, so the whole class interprets+paints on the UI thread - the decline is the dominant real-world cost, measured here at the VM layer. Corpus file checked in (gen_type3_pdf.dart, seed 20260724).

type3-text-render.note: Rasterizes the Type3 doc (CharProc re-execution + per-occurrence inline ImageMask decode + paint). Companion of type3-text-sweep for the raster half of #535.

hatch-sections-sweep.note: 4 A1 sheets with ~70 tiling-pattern-hatched regions each (PatternType 1: diagonal/cross/dot + an uncolored rotated hatch; ~90k cell executions -> ~300k device commands per page under per-tile re-interpretation). The #524 record-once/replay-per-tile measurement anchor. Corpus file is checked in (gen_hatch_pdf.dart, seed 20260724).

jbig2-scanned-sweep.note: The scanned-book JBIG2 shape (#557): one shared /JBIG2Globals stream carrying a 900-symbol arithmetic symbol dictionary, referenced by 32 per-page JBIG2Decode images (1700x2200, ~2.7k symbol instances each). Every in-repo JBIG2 file inlines its globals into a single image, so this is the only workload that exhibits the #532 globals cache - the saving is one dictionary arithmetic-decode per page that no longer happens, and it scales with symbols x pages. Generated + pre-seeded (gen_jbig2_scanned_pdf.dart, seed 20260725) because JBIG2 arithmetic encoding needs jbig2enc, absent from CI - the pure-Dart encoder in pdf_test_fixtures stands in.

jbig2-scanned-render.note: Rasterizes the scanned-book JBIG2 doc (globals-shared symbol decode + text-region composition + 1-bit-to-RGBA expansion + paint). Raster half of #557; same generated corpus as jbig2-scanned-sweep.
